site.name: SMS Code by SIMNETIQ
site.appDescription: Virtual numbers in 100+ countries for receiving SMS verification codes. Sign up for Telegram, WhatsApp, Google and 100+ services without giving out your personal number.

footer.tagline: A phone number for the sign-up. Not for life.

cookies.bannerBody: With your OK, we use analytics to see which pages actually help people, and the Meta Pixel to measure our ads. Nothing runs until you choose.
cookies.dialogIntro: Choose what this site may use. You can change your mind any time from the footer.
cookies.necessaryBody: One cookie that remembers this choice, so we don’t ask on every page.
cookies.analyticsBody: Vercel Web Analytics and Google Analytics count visits and clicks so we can see which pages are useful. Google Analytics sets _ga cookies. Never used for advertising.
cookies.marketingBody: The Meta Pixel tells us when a visit came from one of our ads on Facebook or Instagram, so we can see which ads work. It sets the _fbp cookie, and Meta may also use this data under its own policy.
